releaseNotes: v1.20.1: honest ticks, everywhere. Delivery receipts (the two checkmarks) are now truthful and self-healing — they survive app restarts, network blips and sleeping phones, and stuck single-ticks repair themselves automatically. Transfers detect a frozen connection and retry on their own. Chats are always in perfect time order with new Today/Yesterday day separators. Fullscreen photo viewer with pinch-to-zoom and pan. Leave the app during a call and a floating picture-in-picture window keeps the call in view — tap to jump back in. Plus video call and player polish.
